Keyboard geometry is based on the publicly distributed Link65 Hotswap definition.
VIA, Owlab, and Apple are referenced for compatibility and design context.
This application is independently developed.

Bundled Link65 Studio firmware v1.0.2-rc1 (GNU GPL v3):
https://github.com/gapfixnid/link65_firmware/tree/v1.0.2-rc1
The complete corresponding source, pinned upstream dependencies and build
instructions are available from that tag. The binary is not modified by this site.

The DfuSe transport is implemented in this project. Protocol references:
USB DFU 1.1 specification and ST DfuSe extension, as implemented in dfu-util.
https://www.usb.org/sites/default/files/DFU_1.1.pdf
https://dfu-util.sourceforge.net/
